entries.title: Ezekiel 30:1
segments: ¶The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:2
segments: "Son of man, prophesy and say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "Wail, 'Woe to the day!'

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:3
segments: For the day [is] near, Even the day of the LORD [is] near; It will be a day of clouds, the time of the Gentiles.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:4
segments: The sword shall come upon Egypt, And great anguish shall be in Ethiopia, When the slain fall in Egypt, And they take away her wealth, And her foundations are broken down.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:5
segments: "Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, all the mingled people, Chub, and the men of the lands who are allied, shall fall with them by the sword."

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:6
segments: 'Thus says the LORD: "Those who uphold Egypt shall fall, And the pride of her power shall come down. From Migdol [to] Syene Those within her shall fall by the sword," Says the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:7
segments: "They shall be desolate in the midst of the desolate countries, And her cities shall be in the midst of the cities [that are] laid waste.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:8
segments: Then they will know that I [am] the LORD, When I have set a fire in Egypt And all her helpers are destroyed.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:9
segments: On that day messengers shall go forth from Me in ships To make the careless Ethiopians afraid, And great anguish shall come upon them, As on the day of Egypt; For indeed it is coming!"

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:10
segments: 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "I will also make a multitude of Egypt to cease By the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:11
segments: He and his people with him, the most terrible of the nations, Shall be brought to destroy the land; They shall draw their swords against Egypt, And fill the land with the slain.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:12
segments: I will make the rivers dry, And sell the land into the hand of the wicked; I will make the land waste, and all that is in it, By the hand of aliens. I, the LORD, have spoken."

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:13
segments: 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "I will also destroy the idols, And cause the images to cease from Noph; There shall no longer be princes from the land of Egypt; I will put fear in the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:14
segments: I will make Pathros desolate, Set fire to Zoan, And execute judgments in No.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:15
segments: I will pour My fury on Sin, the strength of Egypt; I will cut off the multitude of No,

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:16
segments: And set a fire in Egypt; Sin shall have great pain, No shall be split open, And Noph [shall be in] distress daily.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:17
segments: The young men of Aven and Pi Beseth shall fall by the sword, And these [cities] shall go into captivity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:18
segments: At Tehaphnehes the day shall also be darkened, When I break the yokes of Egypt there. And her arrogant strength shall cease in her; As for her, a cloud shall cover her, And her daughters shall go into captivity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:19
segments: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt, Then they shall know that I [am] the LORD."'"

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:20
segments: ¶And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first [month], on the seventh [day] of the month, [that] the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:21
segments: "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and see, it has not been bandaged for healing, nor a splint put on to bind it, to make it strong enough to hold a sword.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:22
segments: "Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: 'Surely I [am] against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, both the strong one and the one that was broken; and I will make the sword fall out of his hand.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:23
segments: 'I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them throughout the countries.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:24
segments: 'I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put My sword in his hand; but I will break Pharaoh's arms, and he will groan before him with the groanings of a mortally wounded [man].

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:25
segments: 'Thus I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; they shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I put My sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he stretches it out against the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:26
segments: 'I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them throughout the countries. Then they shall know that I [am] the LORD.'"
